```yaml
name: Publish connectors prerelease command

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        required: true
        type: string
      pr_branch:
        required: true
        type: string
      sha:
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Get short SHA
        id: short_sha
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const fullSha = process.env.SHA;
            return fullSha.substring(0, 10);
        env:
          SHA: ${{ inputs.sha }}

      - name: Post start comment
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          body: |
            :rocket: Publishing pre‑release connectors for PR #${{ inputs.pr_number }}.
            Expected image tags: `{version}-dev.${{ steps.short_sha.outputs.result }}`.

      - name: Publish connectors
        id: publish
        uses: ./.github/workflows/publish_connectors.yml
        with:
          release-type: pre-release
          modified: true
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Post success comment
        if: ${{ steps.publish.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          body: |
            :white_check_mark: Pre‑release connectors published successfully for PR #${{ inputs.pr_number }}.

      - name: Post failure comment
        if: ${{ steps.publish.outcome == 'failure' }}
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          body: |
            :x: Failed to publish pre‑release connectors for PR #${{ inputs.pr_number }}.
```
